effects.fence: Stop future access and new tasks under the previous scope while retaining holdings history. Save the current account scope again, then authorize an agent.
effects.disconnect: Stop future use and updates. Existing holdings remain readable after unlocking. Importing again requires independent data.
effects.delete: Hide this data and its holdings history, and stop future access. Server ciphertext and backups may be retained; this does not mean immediate physical erasure.

lifecycle.unknown: This data state is unconfirmed. Check it again before saving or changing access.

vaultManagement.title: Library keys and devices
vaultManagement.description: Review which browser keys may write encrypted content and check your existing Passkey.
vaultManagement.identityHelp: Google signs you into the platform. Your Passkey separately unlocks the encrypted library; being signed in does not decrypt it.
vaultManagement.firstUseLoss: Keep access to this Passkey. After unlocking, create an independent recovery file and save its separate code. If all usable keys and recovery items are lost, Google sign-in or the platform cannot decrypt your old content.
vaultManagement.localFirst: The main button asks to prefer this device. Your system may still offer other choices. This page never automatically retries on a phone if the operation fails.
vaultManagement.samePasskey: Use the current library Passkey for this library. Creating a different Passkey cannot unlock the existing archive.
vaultManagement.otherTitle: Use a phone or security key
vaultManagement.otherHelp: Choose this only if the current library Passkey is available there and supports PRF. A nearby-phone flow may ask for Bluetooth to confirm proximity. A security key must support the required features.
vaultManagement.otherNoFallback: This is an explicit alternative, not an automatic retry. You may cancel the system prompt and return here.
vaultManagement.unlockOther: Use the current library Passkey there
vaultManagement.unlockLocal: Unlock with the current library Passkey
vaultManagement.deviceApprovalHelp: The archive unlocked, but this browser is not yet registered to write. Approval generates its own new keys and submits a root-signed directory update. Revoked old keys and grants stay revoked. Canceling does not register it.
vaultManagement.deviceApprovalTrust: Compare the root fingerprint with a trusted device or your known record. This page alone cannot prove that the server supplied the globally latest directory.
vaultManagement.notConfigured: Private library management is not enabled on this deployment. Market remains available.
vaultManagement.signInHelp: Sign in to manage only your own library. Keys and decrypted content stay unavailable until you unlock.
vaultManagement.loadDirectory: Load the verified device list before changing keys.
vaultManagement.devicesHelp: These identifiers name cryptographic keys, not a verified physical-device identity. Check both fingerprints before changing access.
vaultManagement.readOnly: This session can read history, but cannot manage current device access. Unlock with a usable registered device to make changes.
vaultManagement.rotateHelp: Confirmation replaces this browser’s signing and encryption keys and revokes the old pair. It does not change the library Passkey or root.
vaultManagement.revokeHelp: Confirmation removes future write and recipient eligibility for this key pair. It cannot erase plaintext or old keys already copied elsewhere.
vaultManagement.grantImpact: Existing agent grants that name a revoked encryption key may stop future report writes. Review and approve new recipients explicitly; nothing is silently reauthorized.
vaultManagement.passkeyNotRevoked: Revoking device keys does not revoke the Passkey or root authority. A person who still holds that Passkey may approve new device keys. Historical owner reading is retained where the keys remain available.
vaultManagement.reviewStale: The verified directory changed. Cancel this review, refresh, and review the new state before confirming.
vaultManagement.pendingReady: The save outcome may be unknown. Retry only the original signed packet, or check its state. Do not generate another candidate or discard this one while a late save may still succeed.
vaultManagement.pendingApplied: The verified directory contains the original change. Finish adopting its stored keys without submitting a different change.
vaultManagement.pendingConflict: A newer verified directory does not contain this change. It is safe to discard this unsubmitted candidate, then review the current directory again.
vaultManagement.verificationHelp: This root and checkpoint were checked in the unlocked client. A server-provided fingerprint alone is not an independent freshness guarantee.
vaultManagement.recoveryHelp: This checks that your current library Passkey can still decrypt the current archive and match its root. It does not create an independent recovery method, change keys, or register another device.
vaultManagement.recoveryLimits: Google sign-in or an administrator cannot decrypt a lost library. Independent recovery requires an encrypted recovery file and its separately saved code, created while you still have access. The check below only verifies the current Passkey; it does not verify a separate backup.
vaultManagement.checkRecovery: Check the current library Passkey on this device
vaultManagement.checkRecoveryOther: Check the current library Passkey elsewhere
vaultManagement.recoveryChecked: The current library Passkey decrypted this archive successfully at {date}. This is not proof of an independent backup.

errors.passkey_unsupported: This authenticator does not provide the required verified Passkey and PRF capability. Try a supported browser or explicitly select another authenticator.
errors.passkey_cancelled: The Passkey operation was canceled or not completed. Nothing is retried automatically.
errors.unlock_failed: The library could not be decrypted and verified. Check the current Passkey or the matching recovery file and code. No replacement library was created.
errors.unlock_required: Unlock your library before managing keys.
errors.wrong_account: The key material does not belong to the current account.
errors.key_revoked: Required keys are no longer authorized for this action. Revoking device keys does not revoke the library Passkey. For expired certificates, use Review key renewal below; revoked keys need another trusted device or recovery.
errors.device_limit: The existing device or directory limit prevents this change. No extra keys were authorized.
errors.version_conflict: The saved directory changed. Refresh and review before any new operation.
errors.registry_conflict: The directory could not be reconciled with the trusted checkpoint. The change stopped.
errors.pending_registration: Finish checking the original pending device registration before creating another.
errors.device_change_pending: Finish the original device operation before changing access again.
errors.device_change_conflict: The pending change conflicts with the verified directory. Check its state before discarding or reviewing again.
errors.device_unavailable: The selected device is no longer eligible for this operation. Refresh the verified list.
errors.operation_conflict: Another tab changed this stored operation. Refresh before continuing.
errors.storage_unavailable: Encrypted local storage is unavailable. Keys and changes were not replaced.
errors.service_unavailable: The encrypted-library service is unavailable. Your Google account remains signed in.
errors.request_timeout: The operation timed out. Check the original saved operation before retrying.
errors.request_failed: The key operation could not be verified. Refresh before continuing.
errors.archive_local_pending: Finish or explicitly discard unfinished task drafts, device changes, and agent approvals in their own screens before replacing the Passkey. Your encrypted records have been preserved.
errors.archive_change_pending: Finish or safely cancel the original archive update before starting another. Its encrypted candidate has been preserved.
errors.archive_session_stale: Another browser updated the protecting Passkey. Unlock again with the current Passkey before making changes.
errors.invalid_replacement_passkey: The replacement must be a newly created, verified Passkey. No archive update was sent.
errors.recovery_authorization_pending: A temporary recovery approval is still pending, or the signed history has reached its limit. Finish the existing operation; do not create another recovery candidate.
errors.archive_change_unknown: The original save outcome has not been proven. Keep its encrypted candidate and check or resume the same operation.
errors.untrusted_lifecycle: The archive signature or history could not be verified against your trusted record. The library was locked.
errors.invalid_recovery_kit: The recovery file or separate code has an invalid format. Use both items from the same export.
errors.archive_change_missing: This browser has no saved unfinished archive update. Use the current library Passkey or your independent recovery file and code.
errors.archive_cancellation_capacity: The signed history has no space to safely fence this unfinished update. Its encrypted candidate has been kept. Do not delete it or create another replacement; resume the original operation if it remains eligible.
errors.archive_cancel_limit: The signed history has no space to safely fence this unfinished update. Its encrypted candidate has been kept. Do not delete it or create another replacement; resume the original operation if it remains eligible.

notices.device_change_saved: The device change was verified and saved. Existing agent grants were not reauthorized.
notices.device_change_discarded: The conflicting unsubmitted candidate was discarded. No new device change was sent.
notices.device_registered: This browser’s independent device keys were registered.
notices.recovery_verified: The current library Passkey decrypted the current archive successfully.

vaultManagement.createOtherHelp: This creates a new library Passkey on the authenticator you explicitly choose. A nearby phone may ask for Bluetooth to confirm proximity; the authenticator must support verified user presence and PRF.
vaultManagement.unusedCredential: If the system already created an unused Passkey before this failed, this page cannot delete it. You may manage that unused credential in your password manager; keep the current library Passkey protecting an existing library.
vaultManagement.recoveryValidityHelp: This is the existing recovery recipient’s current validity, not a perpetual recovery guarantee. Checking or replacing a Passkey does not renew this certificate.
vaultManagement.recoveryUnavailable: The current recovery recipient certificate is unavailable or expired, so this check cannot confirm current recovery capability. It does not mean an administrator can recover the contents.
vaultManagement.enableChanges: Review write access for this browser
vaultManagement.sharedUnlockHelp: Library unlocked for Resources, Tasks, Agent, Inbox and Settings.

vaultRecovery.title: Recovery and a new Passkey
vaultRecovery.description: Keep an independent way to unlock this library, or replace the Passkey that protects its encrypted keys.
vaultRecovery.limits: A new Passkey keeps the same library root and content. It does not revoke old recovery kits, erase previously copied keys, or renew expired recipient certificates. Full root replacement and data re-encryption are not available here.
vaultRecovery.exportTitle: Save the file and code separately
vaultRecovery.exportHelp: Both are required to recover your library. Anyone with both can recover its root authority. The platform cannot recover a lost code for you.
vaultRecovery.codeHelp: Save this code separately from the downloaded file. It is only shown for this export and is cleared when you close it, lock, sign out, or change account.
vaultRecovery.exportCheck: Check that you saved both items before closing. Downloading a file does not prove that your backup can be recovered.
vaultRecovery.changeHelp: Your current encrypted holdings, tasks and reports keep their keys. We first create and test a new Passkey, then save the updated encrypted archive. Finish any pending local drafts or key operations first. An interrupted save must be checked using its original operation.
vaultRecovery.localFirst: The main button prefers this device. You handle the system confirmation yourself. The old Passkey is not automatically deleted from your password manager.
vaultRecovery.confirmChange: Create and verify a replacement Passkey
vaultRecovery.otherHelp: Choose this explicitly to use a compatible phone or security key with verified user presence and PRF. A nearby-phone flow may request Bluetooth. There is no automatic fallback.
vaultRecovery.changeOther: Create replacement on the selected authenticator
vaultRecovery.importTitle: Lost access? Use your recovery kit
vaultRecovery.importHelp: While signed into the same Google account, choose the encrypted recovery file and enter its separate code. You do not need the old Passkey. A new Passkey is created and tested before the archive update is saved.
vaultRecovery.deviceHelp: Recovery does not reactivate revoked browser keys or agent grants. A new browser must be approved explicitly before it can write.
vaultRecovery.importPrivacy: The file and code are opened in this browser’s isolated cryptographic session. They are not sent to the platform. The code is cleared from this form when you continue.
vaultRecovery.recover: Recover and create a new Passkey
vaultRecovery.pendingReady: The save outcome may be unknown. Check the saved state or retry the exact original operation. Do not create another Passkey or discard the stored candidate while the save could still succeed.
vaultRecovery.pendingApplied: The original update is confirmed. Finish adopting its verified archive; an old receipt cannot replace a newer archive.
vaultRecovery.pendingConflict: A newer verified archive conflicts with this candidate. Refresh the current state before continuing. This view will not replace it with the older candidate.
vaultRecovery.unlockPending: If this page no longer has its unlocked cryptographic session, unlock with the current Passkey or resume below using the new Passkey that was already created. Do not start another replacement while its outcome is unknown.

errors.file_size: Choose a nonempty recovery file smaller than 128 KiB.
errors.file_read: The recovery file could not be read. Choose the encrypted recovery file again.
errors.stale_recovery_kit: This recovery kit does not contain a currently eligible recovery key. It may predate a key renewal or no longer be usable. Use the latest recovery kit or a trusted device that can still unlock the library.

vaultRecovery.saved: The new Passkey and encrypted archive were saved and verified. Unlock the library with the new Passkey to continue.
vaultRecovery.resumeTitle: Already created a new Passkey before an interruption?
vaultRecovery.resumeHelp: Resume the locally saved candidate using that new Passkey, even if the server still has the old archive. This only checks the original stored operation; it does not create another credential. If no candidate is saved in this browser, use your current Passkey or independent recovery kit.
vaultRecovery.resumeOther: Resume with the new Passkey elsewhere
vaultRecovery.cancelChangeHelp: We first verify that the original update can no longer replace the current archive. Until that is confirmed, the encrypted candidate is kept. You may need to unlock again with the current saved Passkey. This does not delete any Passkey from your password manager.
vaultRecovery.cancelled: The unfinished update was safely canceled after verification. The currently saved archive was kept. Unlock with its current Passkey to continue.

vaultRenewal.title: Renew library keys
vaultRenewal.description: Replace the browser and recovery keys before or after their certificates expire. Your library Passkey stays the same.
vaultRenewal.help: Finish or save local drafts first. Review opens a session used only for key renewal; holdings, tasks, Inbox actions and agent authorization stay locked.
vaultRenewal.impact: Existing reports and holdings remain encrypted. Old reader keys are retained for your history. Agents are not automatically authorized again.
vaultRenewal.otherTitle: Use a phone or security key
vaultRenewal.otherHelp: Choose this only if your current library Passkey is there and supports PRF. Your system may ask for Bluetooth when using a nearby phone.
vaultRenewal.restricted: Only key renewal is open. Ordinary library access and agent authorization remain locked until you finish and unlock again.
vaultRenewal.reviewHelp: Confirmation creates fresh browser and recovery keys and saves a new encrypted archive. Your sign-in identity and library Passkey stay the same; the server cannot read your private content.
vaultRenewal.missingDevice: This browser has no eligible key pair to renew.
vaultRenewal.root: The library root has no certificate expiration. This action does not replace it.
vaultRenewal.pendingTitle: A key renewal needs your attention
vaultRenewal.pendingReady: Keep this browser’s original encrypted candidate. Check the original receipt before retrying the same request.
vaultRenewal.pendingApplied: The renewal was accepted. Verify its original receipt and finish saving this browser’s keys.
vaultRenewal.pendingConflict: The directory or archive changed. This candidate cannot be submitted. Safely clear it after checking the current signed history.
vaultRenewal.cancelHelp: Cancellation submits a competing signed archive update. If the renewal already won, finish it instead. Keep the encrypted candidate until the outcome is verified.
vaultRenewal.cancelPending: Cancellation is pending. Check the outcome or retry this same cancellation; a new renewal will not be created.
vaultRenewal.stopHelp: Stopping clears the open session. An encrypted pending request stays on this browser for later receipt recovery.
vaultRenewal.saved: Library keys renewed. Unlock again with the same Passkey, then immediately create an updated independent recovery kit. An old kit cannot recover new content saved after renewal; keep the old kit until its replacement is safely stored.
vaultRenewal.cancelled: The pending renewal was safely cleared. Your library is locked.

reasons.device_required: Unlock with a previously registered browser to renew its key pair.
reasons.keys_revoked: Revoked keys cannot be renewed. Use another trusted device or the separate recovery flow.
reasons.pending_operation: Finish the existing local change or encrypted outbox before renewing keys.
reasons.recovery_authorization_pending: Resolve the pending recovery authorization before renewing keys.
reasons.capacity: The current signed history has reached its safe limit. A new renewal cannot be created.

errors.key_renewal_pending: An encrypted key renewal already exists. Review and recover its original outcome.
errors.key_renewal_missing: No pending key renewal was found in this browser.
errors.key_renewal_conflict: The directory or archive changed. Check the candidate before continuing.
errors.key_renewal_required: These certificates require renewal. Open the renewal review with the current Passkey.
errors.key_renewal_only: This session can only renew keys. Finish or lock it before opening private content.
errors.key_renewal_cancel_pending: Check the pending cancellation before continuing.
errors.request_failed: The renewal could not finish. Keep the original encrypted request and check its outcome before retrying.
errors.key_renewal_local_pending: Pending encrypted requests are preserved. Use the holdings or task check to verify already-saved uploads. Unknown outcomes and other pending changes still block renewal.
errors.key_renewal_unknown: The original renewal outcome has not been verified. Keep its encrypted candidate and review with the same library Passkey.
errors.renewal_too_early: These keys were issued too recently to extend their validity yet. Wait briefly, then review again. No new renewal was submitted.
errors.too_large: The encrypted archive or retained key history has reached its safe size limit. The current library and pending encrypted records were kept.
errors.storage_unavailable: Encrypted browser storage is unavailable. The library was locked; review again before retrying. Existing encrypted candidates are retained.
errors.unlock_failed: The current Passkey could not decrypt and verify this library. No key renewal was submitted.
errors.invalid_signature: The renewal signatures could not be verified. The encrypted candidate was retained; do not generate another request.
errors.untrusted_lifecycle: The saved archive history could not be verified. The library was locked; check the current account and trusted device.
errors.passkey_cancelled: Passkey confirmation was canceled or not completed. No new keys were submitted automatically.
errors.passkey_unsupported: This browser or authenticator cannot provide the required Passkey protection. Explicitly choose another supported authenticator.
errors.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable. If a request was sent, keep its encrypted candidate and check the original receipt before retrying.
errors.request_timeout: The operation timed out and the library was locked. Review again with the same Passkey to recover any pending encrypted request.
errors.key_renewal_holdings_review_required: Review the saved holdings upload before confirming.
errors.key_renewal_holdings_changed: The reviewed evidence changed or is no longer available. The original upload is preserved; check it again.
errors.key_renewal_task_review_required: Review the exact saved task before confirming.
errors.key_renewal_task_changed: The reviewed task evidence changed or is unavailable. The original encrypted request is preserved; check it again.
errors.upload_cancellation_unknown: Cancellation is not confirmed. Both original encrypted requests are preserved; continue checking the same cancellation.
errors.upload_cancellation_saved_unverified: The upload was already saved, but the original encrypted result could not be verified. Both local requests are preserved.
errors.upload_cancellation_review_required: Review this exact pending upload before confirming cancellation.
errors.upload_cancellation_pending: Continue the original cancellation before clearing this retry copy.

vaultRenewal.holdingsHelp: You can check an earlier holdings upload even after its signing certificate expires. This only reads the original receipt and encrypted snapshot. Nothing is uploaded again, and private content stays locked. Use the separate task check for task uploads; other pending changes still need their original flow.
vaultRenewal.holdingsNone: No pending upload was found for the current holdings sources in this browser. Other pending changes may still block renewal.
vaultRenewal.holdingsSaved: The original receipt and saved encrypted snapshot match this browser’s pending upload, including its signing proof at the time of saving. Review before removing the local retry copy; the saved snapshot will stay on the server.
vaultRenewal.holdingsUnknown: The saved outcome could not be established. The original upload is still kept in this browser, and renewal remains blocked. Check again later. A missing receipt does not prove the upload failed.
vaultRenewal.holdingsConfirm: Confirm saved upload and clear local retry copy
vaultRenewal.holdingsReconciled: The verified local retry copy was cleared. The saved encrypted snapshot is unchanged. Check any other pending uploads before renewing.
vaultRenewal.taskHelp: Check earlier task saves one at a time, even after their signing certificates expire. Only the original encrypted operation is read; nothing is uploaded again or decrypted. Confirming a saved operation clears its local retry copy without deleting the task. Unknown outcomes remain preserved and block renewal.
vaultRenewal.taskNone: No pending task uploads were found in this browser. Other pending changes may still block renewal.
vaultRenewal.taskSaved: The exact original task save was verified. You can confirm clearing its local encrypted retry copy.
vaultRenewal.taskUnknown: The original save is not confirmed. Its encrypted retry copy is preserved. Check again or review cancellation of further submission.
vaultRenewal.taskReconciled: The saved task’s local retry copy was cleared. Check again for other pending tasks, then review renewal.
vaultRenewal.taskConfirm: Confirm saved task and clear local retry
vaultRenewal.taskKeep: Keep the original request and lock
vaultRenewal.cancelHoldings: Review cancellation of the original holdings upload
vaultRenewal.cancelTask: Review cancellation of the original task upload
vaultRenewal.cancelUploadHelp: This stops further submission of this exact request. If it was already saved, the saved data is kept and its original encrypted result is verified before clearing the local retry copy. Unknown outcomes preserve both requests so you can continue later.
vaultRenewal.cancelUploadConfirm: Confirm cancellation of the original upload
vaultRenewal.cancelUploadPending: The original upload and its signed cancellation are preserved. Continue checking the same cancellation; a new request will not be generated.
vaultRenewal.cancelUploadSavedUnverified: The upload was already saved, but its original encrypted result is not verified yet. Both local requests are preserved; cancellation does not delete saved data.
vaultRenewal.uploadCancelled: The original upload is cancelled and cannot be submitted again. Its matching local retry copies were cleared. Check other pending work before renewal.
vaultRenewal.uploadAlreadySaved: The upload had already been saved. Its original encrypted result was verified and only its local retry copies were cleared. Saved data is kept.
vaultRenewal.cancelUploadCapacity: Holdings and task uploads each retain at most 32 cancellation decisions per library. Retrying the original cancellation does not use another slot. At capacity the original requests remain preserved.

vaultDeletion.title: Cloud key archive
vaultDeletion.description: Remove the encrypted key package stored in the cloud. Your library identity, saved holdings, tasks and reports remain.
vaultDeletion.effects: After removal, the original Passkey alone cannot unlock the library. Approved devices and Agent connections, downloaded copies and recovery packages remain valid.
vaultDeletion.recoveryWarning: Without independent recovery material, access to the encrypted content may be lost permanently. This does not reset your library or revoke other devices.
vaultDeletion.backupLink: Save a current independent recovery package above first
vaultDeletion.backupConfirmation: I have safely stored the current recovery file and its code separately, and understand that losing them may prevent recovery.
vaultDeletion.confirmDeletion: Confirm and remove cloud key archive
vaultDeletion.pendingHelp: Keep the original request while its outcome is unknown. Checking reads state; continuing retries the retained original command.
vaultDeletion.withdrawalPendingHelp: The withdrawal request is retained. Continuing retries its withdrawal only; it does not send the removal command again.
vaultDeletion.withdrawalHelp: Verify the original Passkey to approve keeping the cloud archive. If removal already won, withdrawal cannot undo it; use independent recovery instead.
vaultDeletion.otherPasskey: Use a phone or security key
vaultDeletion.deleted: The cloud key archive has been removed. Use an independent recovery package to restore it and create a new Passkey.

notices.withdrawn: The original removal was withdrawn; the cloud key archive remains. Unlock again to continue.
notices.superseded: A later key change permanently superseded the original removal. Unlock the current archive to continue.

errors.archive_local_pending: Finish the pending encrypted requests or drafts in this browser before removing the key archive.
errors.archive_change_pending: Another key archive operation is pending. Resolve it before starting a new removal.
errors.archive_deletion_unknown: The outcome is still unknown. The original request is retained; check again or explicitly withdraw it.
errors.archive_deletion_unavailable: A recovery approval or the remaining operation allowance prevents removal. Keep the archive and resolve the pending approval first.
errors.archive_deletion_review_stale: The archive changed after review. Review its current state and confirm again.
errors.archive_deletion_unlock_required: Use the original Passkey to approve withdrawal. Ordinary content access stays locked.
errors.archive_session_stale: The key archive changed. Reload its current state before continuing.
errors.storage_unavailable: This browser could not preserve the request safely. Restore local storage availability before continuing.
errors.passkey_cancelled: Passkey verification was cancelled. The original request remains pending.
errors.passkey_unsupported: This authenticator could not unlock the key archive. Try a supported original Passkey.
errors.request_timeout: The request timed out. Its original command is retained for checking.
errors.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable. Keep the original request and check again later.
errors.untrusted_lifecycle: The signed archive history could not be verified. No pending request was discarded.
errors.operation_conflict: The pending request changed in another tab. Reload and check its current state.
errors.generic: The operation could not finish. Check the original request or review the current key archive before retrying.

persistent.title: Agent
persistent.description: Connect once and keep using approved resources and tasks.
persistent.signInHelp: Sign in to manage your Muse connections.
persistent.unlockHelp: Unlock once for this sign-in to use Resources, Tasks, Agent and Inbox.
persistent.deviceNeeded: Finish registering this browser in Settings
persistent.requestFailed: The operation did not finish. Refresh or resume the pending operation.
persistent.reviewNeeded: Resources or tasks have changed. Check permissions and synchronization.
persistent.reviewChanged: The reviewed content changed. Select and confirm it again.
persistent.accountOnly: After connecting, select tasks and resources. This connection remains available after future sign-ins.
persistent.pairHelp: Check that this request came from the Muse you just connected, then confirm.
persistent.pairMatched: This request matches the Muse connection.
persistent.pairWait: Waiting for Muse confirmation. Finish connecting in Muse, then refresh.
persistent.connectOnce: Add this connection address in Muse once. Keep it connected to run tasks within the approved scope.
persistent.syncHelp: Approved resource updates sync encrypted when you sign in and unlock. Muse can use already synchronized approved versions after sign-out.
persistent.noConnections: No persistent connection yet. Connect in Muse first.
persistent.planEvidenceHelp: Muse reports plan status. The latest activity reflects receipts received by FolioView.
persistent.accessHelp: The selected tasks and listed input resources, including future versions, remain available to this connection. Updates to the same resources need no repeated approval.
persistent.reassign: Assign the selected tasks to this connection and stop their execution by the previous connection.
persistent.confirmAccess: Allow this connection to read the selected tasks and resources and their future versions, and save encrypted reports to Inbox.
persistent.inboxHelp: Read reports from persistent connections. Saved reports remain readable after withdrawing resource permissions.
persistent.loadedReports: {count} reports loaded; filters apply to loaded reports.
persistent.selectReport: Select a report to read it.
persistent.stateUnknown: The saved state is unconfirmed. Resume the original operation to continue.
persistent.verifiedHistory: This report was verified against the library history, approved recipient and run receipt before decryption.
persistent.previousReports: View reports from previous foreground connections

agentAccess.waitingForService: The service is busy. Your connection will continue automatically.
agentAccess.title: Your Agents
agentAccess.description: Authorize an Agent to work with the information you choose and return reports to your Inbox.
agentAccess.signInHelp: Sign in to manage your connections.
agentAccess.unlockHelp: Unlock once to authorize or restore a connection.
agentAccess.deviceNeeded: Finish setting up this device in Settings.
agentAccess.requestFailed: The connection could not be completed. Try again or reconnect from your Agent.
agentAccess.reviewChanged: Your authorization changed. Refresh and review it again.
agentAccess.continueHelp: An earlier authorization is waiting to finish. Continue it below.
agentAccess.accountHelp: After confirming, return to your Agent and open its information authorization page.
agentAccess.authorizeHelp: Review what this Agent may use before connecting.
agentAccess.restoreHelp: Restore the information and tasks you previously authorized for {provider}.
agentAccess.chooseTasks: Choose the tasks you want {provider} to handle.
agentAccess.noAvailableTasks: No available tasks yet. You can connect now and add tasks later.
agentAccess.reconnectHelp: Reconnect FolioView in {provider}, then open the authorization link it provides. For first-time setup, use the connection address below.
agentAccess.notReady: Connections are not available yet. Existing reports remain in your Inbox.
agentAccess.expiryHelp: Authorize again soon to keep your tasks running.
agentAccess.reauthorizeHelp: Open a new authorization link from {provider} to restore this connection.
agentAccess.planReported: Agent reports the plan is enabled
